description: Latest 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings with document links from SEC EDGAR for one US ticker. Not endorsed by the SEC. Price: 10 sats (Lightning) or $0.01 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"stock_filings","data":{"company":{"ticker":"NVDA","cik":"0001045810","name":"NVIDIA CORP"},"count":3,"forms":["8-K","10-Q","10-K"],"filings":[{"form":"8-K","filed":"2026-11-01","accession":"0001045810-26-000001","document_url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000001/nvda-8k.htm","index_url":"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000001/0001045810-26-000001-index.html"}]},"metadata":{"cost_sats":10}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

symbol.description: US ticker. EDGAR accepts any symbol in the SEC company_tickers.json map (featured: SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL, AMD, AVGO, MU, PLTR, NBIS, CRWV, RKLB, INTC, ASTS, HIMS, TSM, SOFI, ORCL, HOOD, NFLX, SMCI, COIN, MSTR, IBIT, MARA, GME).

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_stock_filings
title: SEC EDGAR filings (10 sats L402 or $0.01 USDC x402)
